- Single-family executive home, built 2005
- 6 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, approximately 3,315 sq ft of living space
- Private residential elevator serving both floors (rare in this market)
- Three-car garage; first-floor bedroom for guests or multigenerational living
- Open chef's kitchen with quartz island, professional gas range, opening to family room
- Gated, full-amenity community: clubhouse, fitness center, community pool,
  controlled entry, security patrol, maintained grounds
- Location: central West Broward, near I-75 and Florida's Turnpike.
  Approximate drive times — Miramar Park of Commerce 10 min, Weston 15 min,
  Miami Lakes 20 min, Hard Rock Stadium 20 min, Doral 25 min,
  Fort Lauderdale / FLL 25 min, Miami International Airport 30 min,
  Brickell 35 min, Boca Raton 45 min.
- Nearby employment: Miramar Park of Commerce (~5M sq ft, 150+ companies incl.
  GE, Siemens, Humana, Quest Diagnostics, Nissan, Toyota, Stanley Black & Decker,
